name: Anvil of Apotheosis: Slaves to Darkness Hero

abilities.name: Oath of Supremacy
abilities.effect: If this unit is wholly within enemy territory and charged this phase, for the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Darkoath^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Myrmidon Rage
abilities.effect: While this unit is damaged, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Mighty Chaotic Beast's Talons** is 4.

abilities.name: The Bringer of Fire
abilities.effect: That terrain feature is now set ablaze. Add 1 to this unit's control score for the rest of the battle (this effect is cumulative). In addition, for the rest of the battle, each time a unit (friend or enemy) ends a move within 3" of a terrain feature that has been set ablaze, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature that has not yet been set ablaze within this **^^Hero's^^** combat range to be the target.

abilities.name: Victor of 100 Duels
abilities.effect:
Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or refuse this unit's challenge:
***Accept:*** For the rest of the phase, when this unit and the target are picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability, all of their attacks must target the other unit. In addition, for the rest of the phase, you can re-roll hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks.
***Refuse:*** The target cannot use **^^Fight^^** abilities for the rest of the phase. In addition, you gain 1 command point.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Betrayed by the False God
abilities.effect: You can re-roll hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks that target enemy **^^Order^^** units.

abilities.name: Rampant Mutation
abilities.effect:
This unit must use this ability in each of your hero phases. Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect until the start of your next turn:
**1 *Rotting Skin:*** Inflict 1 mortal damage on this unit. Subtract 1 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.
**2 *Brittle Scales:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target this unit.
**3 *Bestial Tongue:*** You lose 1 command point. This unit cannot use commands.
**4 *Sprouting Tentacles:*** This unit's Move characteristic is 2D6".
**5 *Extra Eyeball:*** Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks.
**6 *Erupting Spikes:*** Each time this unit finishes a pile-in move, pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Reckless Arrogance
abilities.effect: This unit cannot use the 'All-out Defence' command.

abilities.name: Spurned by the Gods
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be picked as a target for the 'Eye of the Gods' ability.

abilities.name: Blood of Molten Varanite
abilities.effect: Roll a dice each time a damage point inflicted by a combat attack is allocated to this unit. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Carve a Bloody Path
abilities.effect: When this unit uses the 'Power Through' command, inflict an additional D3+ 1 mortal damage on the target and add 3" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability.
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature that has not yet been set ablaze within this **^^Hero's^^** combat range to be the target.

abilities.name: Blood-fuelled Menace
abilities.effect: This unit can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Glimpse the Future
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-4, the result corresponds to the battle round in which this unit will be inspired. On a 5+, pick a number. The number you picked corresponds to the battle round in which this unit will be inspired. While this unit is inspired, it has **^^Strike-first^^**.

abilities.name: The Thrill of Battle
abilities.effect: Each time you make a charge roll for this unit, for each dice that was an unmodified 6, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle. Units can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
